verdict.rationale: Nitrokey's own product pages say the keys log in to websites using one-time passwords, and that the Nitrokey 3 combines features including 'one-time passwords', so the OTP capability is first-party. The evidence is only marketing one-liners: it never names TOTP or HOTP, describes slots or setup, or mentions challenge-response. Missing for 10: explicit TOTP/HOTP slot documentation, challenge-response support, setup/usage docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, the key covers legacy one-time-password schemes — TOTP/HOTP slots or challenge-response — for services that still lack WebAuthn

citations.quote: Login to websites (e.g. Google, Facebook) using secure One Time Passwords (OTP), U2F or ordinary static passwords.
The Nitrokey 3 combines the features of previous Nitrokey models: FIDO2, one-time passwords
